title: Claude exposes private chats publicly via share links, risking serious #claudeai #privacy #aileaks
description: Anthropic revealed that conversations shared on Claude.ai have been publicly accessible through search engines. Users unknowingly exposed sensitive data such as API keys, crypto wallets, personal resumes, and legal discussions due to share links that generate publicly indexed pages instead of private ones. This incident highlights a significant privacy risk inherent in AI chat platforms where sharing functions can lead to unintentional data leakage. To protect privacy, users must adjust settings to unshare conversations they do not want public, treating share links like public blog posts. This serves as a critical reminder for individuals and businesses to carefully manage data sharing on AI tools to prevent exposure of confidential information and maintain digital security. #Anthropic #ClaudeAI #PrivacyLeak #DataSecurity #AIChatPrivacy #Cybersecurity #APIKeyLeak #CryptoWalletLeak #LegalData #TechPrivacy #AIChatbot #InformationSecurity #DigitalSafety #TechRisks #ShareSettings
